Take a moment to get comfortable. Loosen anything tight, and let the surface beneath you take your weight.
[pause 22]
This is box breathing. Follow the cues, and breathe through your nose if you can.
[repeat 35]
[in 4] In
[hold 4] Hold
[out 4] Out
[holdout 4] Hold
[/repeat]
Let your breathing return to normal. Notice how you feel.
